Class AddBugemonController

java.lang.Object
controllers.Controller<AddBugemonView>
controllers.AddBugemonController
public class AddBugemonController extends Controller<AddBugemonView>
Controller responsible for the Add Bugemon screen.

This controller initializes the view, loads the available attacks, handles user interactions such as choosing a sprite file, validates the form input through the validation service, and triggers the creation flow for a new Bugemon.

  • Method Details

    • initAddBugemonMenu

      public void initAddBugemonMenu()
      Initializes the Add Bugemon view by populating its choice boxes with the available types, attacks, and starter options.

    • addBugemon

      public void addBugemon()
      Validates the values entered in the form and, if valid, displays a success message summarizing the created Bugemon.

      The actual creation and persistence logic is intended to be added later through a dedicated service.

    • chooseSprite

      public void chooseSprite()
      Opens a file chooser to let the user select a sprite image file.

      Only PNG files are proposed in the chooser. If a file is selected, its absolute path is written into the sprite path field of the view.

    • onTypeSelected

      public void onTypeSelected(String selectedType)

      Parameters:
      selectedType - the type selected by the user
